Serve instructions file links from this site (#293)

Remove the 2 site links to site/downloads/cleanlanguage-instructions.md
on GitHub and point the demo prompt at the copy this site serves, so no
page depends on the repository's site/ folder being public.

- install.html: drop the "View the original on GitHub" sentence; the
  paragraph's link to /downloads/cleanlanguage-instructions.md stays.
- instructions.html: drop the 4th button, "View original on GitHub";
  the 3 download buttons this site serves stay.
- demo.html: the prompt reads the instructions file from
  https://cleanlanguage.ai/downloads/cleanlanguage-instructions.md,
  and the callout says it points only at this project's public
  repository and this site's own files.
- site.json: modified date of the 3 pages set to 2026-11-27.
- site/: the 3 pages and sitemap.xml regenerated by build-site.py and
  generate-sitemap.py --write.
